Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Sanford for 2026, and here is what he found: 13 family events, 8 of them free, with Christmas Dreams (November 28) and the St. Lucia Festival (December 12, free) among the newest. The magic runs from November 27 (Sailing with Santa) through January 17 (Asian Lantern Festival at the Central Florida Zoo), with Light Up Sanford (December 4), Paws and Claus at Fort Mellon Park (December 5) and the Holiday Parade of Lights (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Sanford
